beta_cell_assessment: Dominant beta-cell RTK target [FACT/OBS]: Kd 0.7-43 nM (85.9% occ at free Cmax); #1 highest-expressed nanomolar imatinib kinase target in human beta cells (81.4 nCPM, IHC medium, >10x ABL1/KIT/PDGFR) and #1 Vina score (-12.46 kcal/mol, 0.42 A); regulates islet ECM/collagen remodeling & beta-cell regeneration (PMID:18938156, 21947380, 31207434).

Primary intrinsic beta-cell target [FACT/OBS]: Kd/Ki 1.0 nM (54-99% occ at free Cmax); expressed in beta cells (5.8 nCPM) & islets (80.8 nCPM); c-Abl translocates to ER under stress to hyperactivate IRE1a RNase, and c-Abl siRNA phenocopies imatinib beta-cell survival & NKX2-2/GLUT2/insulin induction (PMID:28380378, 17135364, 24835010).

Co-primary intrinsic beta-cell target [FACT/OBS]: Kd 6.0-12.9 nM (95.3% occ at free Cmax); high islet endocrine expression (92.8 nCPM, beta 9.4 nCPM); redundantly scaffolds & hyperactivates IRE1a at the ER membrane alongside ABL1 (PMID:28380378).

Primary non-kinase intrinsic beta-cell target [FACT/OBS]: Ki 38.9 nM (85.9% occ at free Cmax); expressed in human beta cells (13.8 nCPM) & islets (45.3 nCPM); stacks over FAD in homodimer pocket (3FW1, -9.79 kcal/mol, MD-stable), modulating quinone redox cycling and oxidative stress (PMID:19531561, 39085384).

Islet stromal/juvenile target (disfavoured as adult intrinsic beta-cell target) [FACT/OBS]: Ki 2.0-95.5 nM (73.1% occ), but epigenetically silenced in adult human beta cells (0.24 nCPM, IHC negative); beta-cell Pdgfra KO WORSENS beta-cell apoptosis & glucose intolerance (PMID:21993628, 41234234) — benefit is mediated via islet stroma/vascular remodeling (PMID:19015530).

Islet macrophage paracrine target [FACT/OBS]: Ki 10-158 nM (62.1% occ); 0.00 nCPM in beta cells, but high on islet-resident macrophages where inhibition depletes diacritically inflammatory macrophages in diabetes (PMID:30595478, 31648183).

target_name: Mast/stem cell growth factor receptor Kit (c-Kit)
beta_cell_assessment: Progenitor/vascular RTK (disfavoured in adult beta cells) [FACT/OBS]: Ki 12.6-263 nM (49.7% occ); 0.00 nCPM in adult sorted human beta cells (IHC negative); Kit loss-of-function (Kit^Wv) impairs islet vasculature & beta-cell function, and anti-c-Kit mAb failed to reverse NOD T1D (PMID:19015530, 26253609).

Autoimmune T-cell target in T1D insulitis [FACT/OBS]: Kd/Ki 40-158 nM (62.1% occ); 0.24 nCPM in beta cells; dampens infiltrating cytotoxic T cells rather than intrinsic beta-cell signaling (PMID:16873671).

Islet stellate/fibroblast collagen receptor [FACT/OBS]: Kd 15.1-141 nM (64.8% occ); low in beta cells (1.21 nCPM), enriched in pancreatic stellate cells driving islet fibrosis (PMID:18938156, 22998750).
Hepatic/renal MATE1 transporter [FACT/OBS]: IC50 40-50 nM (83.8% occ); 0.00 nCPM in beta cells; mediates systemic metformin/cation clearance DDI rather than intrinsic islet action.

Exocrine ductal enzyme (non-beta-cell) [FACT/OBS]: Ki 30.2 nM (single stopped-flow report); 0.72 nCPM in beta cells (IHC negative in islets vs medium in exocrine ducts); imatinib docked 4.69 A outside the deep Zn2+ sulfonamide pocket.

Islet pericyte/stromal target [FACT]: Ki 14.1-240 nM (52.0% occ); minimal adult beta-cell expression (0.72 nCPM, IHC negative), enriched in islet pericytes/vasculature; assessed structurally via 82%-identical paralog PDGFRA (6JOL).

target_name: Broad substrate specificity ABC transporter ABCG2 (BCRP)
beta_cell_assessment: Efflux transporter (BCRP) [FACT/OBS]: IC50 0.50-3.7 uM (6.5% occ at free Cmax); cryo-EM co-crystal 6VXH (-10.58 kcal/mol, 0.68 A); 0.24 nCPM in beta cells.

Micromolar cis-amide kinase off-target [FACT/OBS]: Ki 1.6-5.0 uM (4.9% occ at free Cmax); co-crystal 1XBB (-8.88 kcal/mol); 0.24 nCPM in beta cells.
Micromolar p38a kinase [FACT/OBS]: Kd 3.2-10 uM (2.5% occ at free Cmax); co-crystal 3HEC (-11.09 kcal/mol), beta-cell 4.11 nCPM (IHC medium), exposure-incompatible in vivo.

target_name: ATP-sensitive inward rectifier potassium channel 11 (Kir6.2 / KATP)
measured_potency: IC50 (9.4 uM, inside-out beta-cell patch clamp, PMID 33857840)
beta_cell_assessment: In-vitro micromolar KATP channel target [FACT/OBS]: patch-clamp IC50 9.4 uM (PMID:33857840); 2.7% occ at clinical free Cmax (0.26 uM) but ~52% inhibition at 10 uM in vitro; docks into Kir6.2 ATP site (6C3O, -8.91 kcal/mol, MD-stable on LYS39/LYS185/GLU179).

Indirect ER-stress effector (weak direct binding) [FACT/OBS]: direct IRE1a kinase Kd is 10-30 uM (0.9% occ at clinical Cmax), proving imatinib spares beta cells primarily upstream via ABL1/ABL2 scaffolding blockade rather than direct IRE1a ATP-pocket inhibition (PMID:28380378).

beta_cell_assessment: Hematopoietic RTK [FACT/OBS]: WT Kd 10 uM (2.5% occ at free Cmax; 132 nM only on leukemic ITD/mutant); 0.24 nCPM in beta cells.

Secondary sub-micromolar Src-family kinase [FACT/OBS]: IC50/Kd 200-890 nM (22.6% occ at free Cmax); expressed in beta cells (4.11 nCPM) & islets (25.5 nCPM); partial engagement at clinical dose, higher at 3-10 uM in vitro.
Micromolar JNK1 stress kinase [FACT/OBS]: Kd 2.5-5.0 uM (4.9% occ at free Cmax); beta-cell 4.83 nCPM (islet 114 nCPM); weak direct binding.
Micromolar Src-family kinase [FACT/OBS]: Kd 3.1-4.0 uM (6.1% occ at free Cmax); beta-cell 11.84 nCPM.
Efflux transporter (P-gp) [FACT/OBS]: IC50 0.58-7.2 uM (3.5% occ at free Cmax); islet 77.8 nCPM (beta 3.62 nCPM); docks 3.63 A from taxol centroid in 6QEX.

Micromolar JNK3 stress kinase [FACT/OBS]: Kd 1.0-3.1 uM (7.8% occ at free Cmax); highly expressed in beta cells (57.5 nCPM, islet 370 nCPM); docked pose sits 3.21 A from pocket center (2O0U) — JNK suppression in islets is mainly downstream of ABL1/IRE1a.

Beta-cell Src-homology kinase (Bsk/GTK) [FACT]: Kd 0.32-1.5 uM (14.7% occ at free Cmax, ~87% at 10 uM in vitro); expressed in beta cells (3.14 nCPM); promotes cytokine-induced beta-cell apoptosis (PMID:15186217, 17416457). No experimental PDB structure exists for P42685.

MODY11 locus kinase (absent in adult beta cells) [FACT]: Kd 525 nM (33.1% occ); 0.00 nCPM in adult sorted beta cells (0.02 nCPM islet); BLK loss-of-function causes diabetes (opposite of imatinib effect); no PDB structure.

Selectivity counter-screen (spared) [FACT/OBS]: Kd 5.0-10 uM (2.5% occ at free Cmax, >1000x selective vs ABL1/DDR1); docked pose displaced 4.51 A outside INSR ATP pocket (5HHW), confirming physiological beta-cell insulin receptor signaling is spared.

Falsified mitochondrial hypothesis [HYP/OBS]: proposed in PMID:34569605 (462.3 nCPM in beta cells), but unmeasured biochemically; Vina pose landed 5.11 A outside the octanoyl-CoA site (8ZRW) and drifted 4.37 A (to 6.57 A from pocket center) in 250 ps MD — direct orthosteric binding disfavoured.
